part2.question: Describe a live sports event you watched and liked

segments.v: I want to talk about a football match I watched at Hàng Đẫy Stadium last season. It was a match between two teams from Hà Nội. I went with my dad and my uncle. It was on a Saturday evening. There were many fans outside the stadium. Inside, the fans sang and played drums during the match. The match was very exciting. Our team lost one goal first, but then they scored. In the last minute, they scored again and won. Everyone was very happy and they cheered loudly. My dad hugged strangers. I liked it because the atmosphere was great and I watched it with my family. It was more exciting than watching on TV.
